name: Gray Render
description: Large magical beast with 10 RHD. Protector-beast that bonds to a single creature or group, with six eyes, rend, and improved grab. LA +5 (cohort).

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Scent
ability.description: Detect opponents by scent within 30 ft. (60 ft. upwind, 15 ft. downwind).

ability.name: Improved Grab (Ex)
ability.description: On a successful bite attack, may attempt a grapple as a free action without provoking AoOs.

ability.name: Rend (Ex)
ability.description: Winning a grapple check after a successful bite latches onto the opponent and deals automatic 2d6+9 damage.

ability.name: Bonded Guardian
ability.description: Gray renders bond to a single creature or small group, watching over them and bringing daily meat offerings. Never willingly harms its bonded charges and retreats if they attack it.

name: Griffon
description: Large magical beast with 7 RHD. Eagle-lion hybrid with flight 80, pounce, and rake. LA +3 (cohort).

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Scent
ability.description: Detect opponents by scent within 30 ft.

ability.name: Pounce (Ex)
ability.description: On a dive or charge, can make a full attack including two rake attacks.

ability.name: Rake (Ex)
ability.description: +8 melee, damage 1d6+2 (two rake attacks on pounce).

name: Shadow Mastiff
description: Medium outsider (extraplanar) with 4 RHD. Shadowy canine with panic-inducing bay, trip, and shadow blend. LA +3 (cohort).

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Scent
ability.description: Detect opponents by scent within 30 ft.

ability.name: Bay (Su)
ability.description: When the mastiff howls or barks, all creatures except evil outsiders within 300 ft. must succeed on Will DC 13 or be panicked for 2d4 rounds. Sonic mind-affecting fear. Affected creatures are immune to the same mastiff's bay for 24 hours.

ability.name: Trip (Ex)
ability.description: On a successful bite, may attempt to trip as a free action (+3 modifier) without a touch attack or provoking AoOs. Failure does not allow counter-trip.

ability.name: Shadow Blend (Su)
ability.description: In any illumination other than full daylight, total concealment. Daylight spell negates but ordinary light does not.

ability.name: Scent-Tracking
ability.description: +4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent.

name: Androsphinx
description: Large male magical beast with 12 RHD. Lion-bodied sphinx with paralyzing roar, pounce, rake, and 6th-level cleric spellcasting. LA +5 (cohort).

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Pounce (Ex)
ability.description: On a charge, can make a full attack including two rake attacks.

ability.name: Rake (Ex)
ability.description: +18 melee, damage 2d4+3 (two rake attacks on pounce).

ability.name: Roar (Su)
ability.description: 3/day escalating roar: 1st fear (500 ft., DC 19 Will), 2nd paralysis (250 ft., DC 19 Fort) + deafens (90 ft., no save), 3rd 2d4 Str damage (250 ft., DC 19 Fort) and 2d8 knockdown (90 ft., Medium or smaller). Charisma-based.

ability.name: Divine Spellcasting (6th-Level Cleric)
ability.description: Casts divine spells as a 6th-level cleric with access to Good, Healing, and Protection domains.
